title: ScenarioContract
description: Static contract for a single LowCode example scenario. Pins the expected code structure, symbols, fixture type, and publication status for a given scenario_id.

scenario_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this scenario (e.g. cells-html-converter)

family.description: Plugin family this scenario belongs to

type_name.description: Short class name of the LowCode workflow type (e.g. HtmlConverter)

primary_method.description: The primary method demonstrated in the example (e.g. Process, Convert)

fixture_type.description: How the test fixture (input file) is provided

expected_symbols.description: Symbols that MUST appear in generated code (short or fully-qualified names)

forbidden_patterns.description: Code patterns that must NOT appear in generated code

validation_method.description: How to validate the output (e.g. file_exists, pdf_header_check, docx_zip_check)

publication_status.description: Current publication status of this scenario's example

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle stage at time of contract creation

evidence_sources.description: Relative paths to evidence files backing this contract

last_verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when contract was last verified against source evidence

notes.description: Optional human notes about this contract
